title: Generation, Sight, and the Forming of Truth in the Natural
summary: How the natural produces and how truth takes form in it. T87 describes the three modes by which the natural brings forth as flesh — and the two paths to holiness, the untouched virgin and the purified continent. T88 reveals the body as twelve openings (seven gates of head, five lower openings) and the soul that recognizes them for what they are. T89 reads why the man stooping to water sees his face inverted as the mystery of the Call descending and the Answer ascending. T90 names the five offspring of food in the body, of which the soul recognizes only one. T91 explains why the illumining principles within do not yet rejoice wholly — they grieve over the proprium and over the soul still drawn taut. T92 traces how interior truth takes outward form through the five articulating degrees, like a coin minted by five craftsmen. T93 explains why the same natural mind brings forth fruit sweet in one place and bitter in another — the Lord's nourishing or the proprium's shadow inundating the same elements.
organizing_principle: How the natural mind generates and how truth takes form in it: from begetting in three modes (T87) and the holiness of virgin/continent (T88), through the inverted image at the water as Call/Answer mystery (T89), the five offspring of nourishment (T90), the world's permanent grief (T91), the word's articulation through five members (T92), and the elemental molding of new buds (T93). The arc treats generation as correspondence to divine forming — what the Lord brings forth and what the proprium imitates.
